title: REMAIN CALM Part 1: The Dead Smell Fear | What if zombies could smell fear?
hook: What if the dead could smell fear?
description:
What if the dead could smell fear?

At FRESHWAY 24H, a cashier whose smile never breaks has one night to teach a jumpy security guard to stay calm — before the dead find him.

Real tip: slow breathing (in for 4, out for 6) lowers your heart rate and helps you stay calm when startled.
